description: Return a retained HSE series for construction in Great Britain: worker deaths and the rate per 100,000 workers with the long-run trend, kinds of fatal accident such as falls from height, employee deaths, self-reported and RIDDOR-reported injuries, or work-related ill health. Preserves each series’ period, units, provisional or revised status, confidence intervals, source file and publication date. This does not query a live HSE feed.
